terms.dual-use: able to serve ordinary science and also be misused

explainBack: Provider logs can justify an account ban, but an internal observation is not automatically proof of intent or real-world outcome, and a ban may displace activity elsewhere.
unseenTransfer: For a claim that an AI company stopped government surveillance, check whether it banned accounts, whether the system itself stopped and whether another model replaced it.
